verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a ChatGPT API that matches the UI's capabilities. The only programmatic surfaces mentioned are the Codex SDK and CLI, which are scoped to coding tasks. The docs also state that the CLI lacks the visual preview and annotation interface, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Programmatic access to UI features such as images, documents, Work, browser, computer use and scheduled tasks is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
